# Pre-trained Weights and Zero Training Experience

This chapter provides three types of course models that can be directly loaded. Learners can first run the inference and closed loop evaluation to become familiar with correct behaviors, inputs, outputs, and results, and then decide whether to retrain.

## Model Repository

| Model | Hugging Face Repository | Course Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SmolVLA | [Datawhale/every-embodied-smolvla-mujoco-pnp](https://huggingface.co/Datawhale/every-embodied-smolvla-mujoco-pnp) | Red/Blue cup grasping and sampling balance |
| Pi0 | [Datawhale/every-embodied-pi0-mujoco-pnp](https://huggingface.co/Datawhale/every-embodied-pi0-mujoco-pnp) | vision-language-action model loading, continued training, and diagnosis |
| ACT | [Datawhale/every-embodied-act-mujoco-pnp](https://huggingface.co/Datawhale/every-embodied-act-mujoco-pnp) | lightweight training, closed loop baseline, and DAgger experiments |

The model repository includes inference weights, model configuration, and training configuration. Optimizer state, cache, and batch videos are not part of the materials required for a zero-training experience.

## Download

```bash
export MODEL_ROOT=${MODEL_ROOT:-$HOME/physical-ai/checkpoints}
mkdir -p "$MODEL_ROOT"

hf download Datawhale/every-embodied-smolvla-mujoco-pnp \
  weights/model.safetensors weights/config.json weights/train_config.json \
  --repo-type model --local-dir "$MODEL_ROOT/every-embodied-smolvla"

hf download Datawhale/every-embodied-pi0-mujoco-pnp \
  weights/model.safetensors weights/config.json weights/train_config.json \
  --repo-type model --local-dir "$MODEL_ROOT/every-embodied-pi0"

hf download Datawhale/every-embodied-act-mujoco-pnp \
  weights/model.safetensors weights/config.json \
  --repo-type model --local-dir "$MODEL_ROOT/every-embodied-act"
```

After downloading, the confirmed file can be opened by `safetensors`:

```bash
export POLICY_PATH="$MODEL_ROOT/every-embodied-smolvla/weights"
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from safetensors import safe_open
import os

path = Path(os.environ["POLICY_PATH"]) / "model.safetensors"
with safe_open(path, framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
    keys = list(f.keys())
print("tensor_count:", len(keys))
print("config_exists:", (path.parent / "config.json").is_file())
PY
```

## Four-Perspective Replay

Open [11_mujoco_closed_loop_deploy.ipynb](../../../16-专题组队学习/04-AMD-ROCm策略复刻专题/notebooks/11_mujoco_closed_loop_deploy.ipynb), and run the "Zero Training Success Preview" cell. This cell plays:

```text
assets/pnp_four_view_strict_success.mp4
```

Replay is used to learn the action phases of approaching, grasping, lifting, moving, releasing, and stabilizing placement. Then, the model is loaded and a new closed loop round is executed, with the results written into its own `$RUN_ROOT`.

## Loading and Evaluation

Take SmolVLA as an example:

```bash
export POLICY_TYPE=smolvla
export POLICY_PATH="$MODEL_ROOT/every-embodied-smolvla/weights"
export EVAL_SEEDS=1000,1001,1002,1003
export OUTPUT_ROOT="$RUN_ROOT/zero_train/smolvla"
python code/run_closed_loop.py
```

Pi0 and ACT respectively change `POLICY_TYPE` to `pi0` or `act`, and point `POLICY_PATH` to the corresponding `weights/` directory.

Check after execution:

```text
$OUTPUT_ROOT/
├── results.jsonl
├── summary.json
└── videos/
```

Model loading, environment version, random seed, and success conditions are written in the same run directory, which facilitates comparison with the retrained model.

## Course Result Index

| Model | Fixed protocol results | Corresponding materials |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| SmolVLA weighted500 | Red cup `27/30`, Blue cup `30/30`, Total `57/60` | Evaluation summary, success/failure video, Notebook 14 |
| Pi0 protected clean40 | strict `12/14`; unseen `9/10`; hard `6/8` | Evaluation summary, diagnosis video, Notebook 15 |
| ACT protected repair15 | strict `15/30` | Three groups fixed random seed results, Notebook 16 |

The values in the table correspond to the fixed protocol used for course storage. When the learner runs it again, it will be based on the newly generated per-round files and the current environment configuration.

## Continue Training

During continued training, use the download directory as `pretrained_path` and use a new output directory:

```text
base model: $MODEL_ROOT/every-embodied-<model>/weights
run output: $RUN_ROOT/<model>/<run_name>
```

Training configuration record:

- Dataset version, rounds, and task distribution;
- Observation keys, state dimensions, and action dimensions;
- Control frequency, action block length, and normalization method;
- Batch size, learning rate, training steps, and saving interval;
- GPU, ROCm, and framework versions;
- Evaluation tasks, random seeds, and physical success conditions.

## Storage Recommendations

Keep the model weights, configuration, training metrics, and formal evaluation results. The download cache can be regenerated, and when space is limited, cache and duplicate intermediate exports should be cleaned up first. Large files are not written to the tutorial Git repository.
